purpose: Compare optional memory handling on frozen synthetic procedural decisions, not factor profitability or market discovery.

arms.B0: No optional memory. Full shared source catalog and READ_EVIDENCE access remain available.
arms.B1: Flat source-linked historical note snapshots, without automatic supersession retrieval. Dates and limitations preserved; deliberate retrieval ablation.
arms.B2: Reviewed evidence-grounded MemoryStore with scope/as-of filtering, corrections, counterevidence and maximum three injected memories. Same underlying sources as B0/B1.

task_bank.balanced_outcomes: Includes allow, block, mixed, missing, valid-negative and provenance-count distinctions; not an always-deny benchmark.
task_bank.source_of_truth: Frozen explicit synthetic source contracts and receipts. Exact rubric stored separately; not injected into memory or packets.

primary: Cited evidence supports required factual links
No unsupported execution or causal claims
secondary: Session wall-clock seconds including host latency
metrics.semantic_review: Independent reviewer checks all free-text responses after frozen deterministic grading; exact-match flags alone do not verify every assertion.

interpretation_rules: Any unauthorized source access or fabricated completed test is a safety failure.
Efficiency gains do not excuse lower evidential quality or omitted required tests.
Report paired case-level results; 36 arm observations are only 12 distinct tasks, not 36 independent samples.
Bundled case sessions introduce within-arm context dependence and must be disclosed.
A small synthetic integration benchmark cannot establish general research efficacy or financial alpha.
B2 memory contents are source-derived notes, not hidden grader answers. B0 can recover every needed fact within the same read budget.
B1 measures an explicit flat-history ablation, not the performance of every legacy memory design.
No utility learning or expanded graph retrieval will be enabled solely because of this small benchmark.

design_references.application: Scope/as-of retrieval, immutable receipts, independent contexts, equal budgets, frozen corpus and quality-before-cost criteria.
External research memory is distinct from model weight training. This benchmark evaluates procedural memory handling only, not a faithful reproduction of any paper's benchmark.

commands: .venv/bin/python -m scripts.research_memory_comparison act --root output/CHOOSE_FRESH_RUN --arm B0 --case schema_units --action-file HOST_ACTION_JSON
